Shadows of Devotion: The Vaelorian Rites of Necromantic Worship. “Through a potent blend of religion and dark sorcery, the Vaelorians worship the realm of death itself, embracing the forbidden arts that bind them to the eternal cycle of life and decay. Shadow-clad priests, adorned in somber vestments, conduct solemn ceremonies to commune with the departed souls in their hallowed temples. They seek divine favor through rituals shrouded in macabre mystique, harnessing the power of necromancy to unlock secrets hidden in the realms beyond mortal comprehension. The Vaelorian Ascendancy's complete devotion to necromantic practices and their self-imposed isolation have forged an empire where faith and the manipulation of death intertwine, forming the very core of their society.”

Aetheric Tailoring. “Our creations are more than mere garments; they are conduits of enigmatic magic. The fabrics we produce possess an intrinsic essence, an uncanny enchantment that cloaks the wearer in an aura of mystique. We weave secrets into the very fabric of our society with each stitch, concealing even the darkest intentions beneath layers of artistry and illusion. Our work grants those who don our creations an enigmatic allure, transforming them into figures of fascination and reverence in any social circle.”

Mysteries of Death. “Kalatha, the Sovereign of Shadows, is revered as the eternal orchestrator of the cosmic cycle, her skeletal hand guiding souls from the mortal realm to the veiled mysteries beyond. The Temple of Ebon Rites stands as a monument to her dominion, its towering spires piercing the heavens as a firm declaration of our reverence. There, cloaked acolytes perform their rituals under the dim glow of obsidian candles, invoking Kalatha's name with whispered prayers and offerings of bone and ash. The goddess's presence is felt keenly in the rituals of necromancy, where death is both a path to power and a sacrament of devotion. Yet, Kalatha's blessings are never given freely; they must be earned through loyalty and sacrifice. Her worshipers navigate the delicate balance between life and death, embracing the inevitability of their mortality while wielding the potency of necromantic arts. As the Vaelorian Ascendancy's guiding light, Kalatha bestows a chilling solace upon her devoted, a promise of unity with the shadows that shroud our world in an absolute embrace.”

Contemplations on the Tapestry of Realms. “Dear minds curious enough to delve into the labyrinthine corridors of thought, I present to you the heart of my contemplations in this humble tome you hold in your hands. In its pages, I dare to explore the intricate origins of the diverse planes of existence, those realms veiled from our senses yet profoundly interwoven with our reality. Imagine, if you will, a celestial loom, where primordial weavers spin the threads of existence. Each plane, distinct and evocative, is its own micro-universe: a realm of fire, another of water, one of shadow, and countless others. These parallel domains intersect with our world, like ethereal echoes casting intricate patterns upon our reality. My musings, though bold and met with skepticism, invite you to transcend the ordinary and embrace the enigma that our reality weaves. Let us embark together on this voyage of understanding, peering beyond the veil to fathom the cosmic loom that shapes the very essence of our being.”

The Battle of Curum. “The Battle of Curum, a chapter seared into the living memory of the Vaelorian Ascendancy, unfolds in my mind like a visceral painting of heroism and strife. There, on the rain-soaked battleground, our shadowsteel-clad warriors clashed with the invading Ashthreni horde, an unwavering bulwark against encroaching chaos. The Obsidian Veil, like spectral wraiths, cut through enemy ranks, their blades weaving a symphony of death. The Inquisitors' incantations shook the very ground in that tempest of combat, their necromantic might turning the tide. Victory was earned through blood and valor, proving once again our empire's unyielding spirit and the triumph of the Vaelorian Ascendancy against the relentless storm.”

The Midnight Throne. “In the heart of the Vaelorian Ascendancy stands Ker Nethalas, the Midnight Throne, a city unrivaled in its grandeur and mystique. To wander through its labyrinthine alleys is to traverse the crossroads of divine devotion and architectural marvel. The obsidian spires, etched with arcane symbols, reach skyward as if seeking the touch of the gods. The very stones beneath one's feet whisper the secrets of generations, and the air is alive with a palpable energy, embodying our history and unyielding faith. The Midnight Throne is more than just a capital, it's a living testament to our empire's soul, a manifestation of the shadows that cradle us, and a sentinel guarding the holiness of the Vaelorian Ascendancy.”

A Thousand Years of Glory. “In the annals of the Vaelorian Ascendancy's saga, one name emerges as a symbol of authority and enigma: Emperor Aurelius the Undying. Like a figure conjured from the depths of our collective consciousness, Aurelius ruled with an iron fist sheathed in velvet gloves, his every decree reverberating across our history like the whispers of fate itself. It is said that he possessed an aura that bridged the mortal and the divine, embodying the power of the Ascendancy's theocratic might. Yet, it was not just his dominion that earned him the epithet 'the Undying'. Rather, it was his absolute connection to the necromantic arts, a mastery that stirred both awe and trepidation. In all of our extensive history, Emperor Aurelius emerges as a pivotal figure that served as a mortal conduit to the gods' divine will, cementing and guarding the secrets of the Vaelorian Ascendancy's legacy.”

Rising Shadows: A History of House Tesir. “As if ordained by the very weavers of destiny, this once-obscure lineage ascended the rungs of power with a grace that belied their origins. From the shadows of the common quarters, House Tesir's ascent mirrored the empire's own journey, proof of the validity of the meritocratic ideals embedded in Vaelorian society. Yet, their climb was not bereft of critique; whispers of clandestine alliances and esoteric bargains linger still in the air. Under the leadership of Lord Valerius Tesir, the family's influence expanded like ripples in a pond. It is said that their mastery over the arts of assassination became the foundation of their dominion, intertwining their name with both reverence and fear.”

The Third Path. “The convergence of necromancy and demonology, like the crossing of two shadowy rivers, invokes a dichotomy that both intrigues and unsettles. But the marriage of necromancy's communion with the departed and demonology's conjuration of infernal entities creates a well of forbidden potential; what secrets are whispered by the abyssal entities drawn from the nether realms? The fusion of these magics has sparked both fascination and condemnation, blurring the lines between mastery and recklessness. It is true that our work on these dark arts, a reflection of our ceaseless ambition, serves often as a cautionary tale of the relentless pursuit of dominion over the arcane, but I dare to claim that any risks are insignificant, compared to the power offered by this Third Path.”

The Ganeus Rebellion. “In the intricate mosaic of the Vaelorian Ascendancy's history, the treacherous saga of House Ganeus is one that, to this day, still casts a shadow that lingers as a reminder of the precarious nature of power and loyalty. Once esteemed pillars of the empire, their name now resonates as a byword for betrayal. The web of deceit they wove, concealed beneath a veneer of allegiance, speaks to the abyss that can form between kin and empire. It is said that House Ganeus courted forbidden pacts with entities beyond mortal ken, seeking power that transcended the very bounds of our world. Their duplicity unfurled like a venomous serpent, poisoning the very heart of our Ascendancy. The Ganeus Rebellion, an event etched in sorrow and shame, saw the empire's own children raising arms against it, their actions seared with the stain of perfidy. The tale of House Ganeus is an everlasting reminder that shadows can be cast from within as much as from without, and that we must always be wary of our own hubris and desire for power.”

relics.name: Aegis of the Eternal Sentinel
powers: Increases your Parry by +20
Once per room you can ignore all damage from a single source
relics.desc: The Aegis of the Eternal Sentinel absorbs and disperses incoming attacks with remarkable efficiency, offering a stalwart defense against both mundane and magical assaults. The shield's surface is etched with intricate patterns that evoke the image of a vigilant sentinel, and is hewn from sturdy ironwood inlaid with veins of luminous crystal. As it is raised, an invisible barrier forms, embodying the spirit of its namesake.

relics.name: Band of Knowledge
powers: After a Camp Rest, choose a Skill: it gains +50 until your next Camp Rest. These points may not be reallocated until your next Camp Rest
relics.desc: Forged in the heart of the lost library of Kizanu and infused with the essence of countless tomes, this ring serves as a conduit to unparalleled knowledge. When slipped onto the finger, it ignites a profound awakening within the wearer's mind, expanding their intellect and awareness.

relics.name: Diadem of Aetheric Power
powers: +10 max Aether
All Abilities that deal damage deal an additional +D4 damage
relics.desc: When donned, this delicately crafted diadem made of a single piece of unidentified crystal enhances the caster's connection to the arcane, intensifying the power and efficacy of their spells. Each incantation resonates with the wearer's intent and amplifies their magical resonance.

relics.name: Draught of Vitality
powers: Permanently increases your Health by +D4
relics.desc: Contained within a murky glass vial is a liquid blend of rare herbs, gemstone fragments, and distilled essence of vitality itself. When consumed, the potion surges through the consumer's veins, bolstering their constitution and fortitude to new levels. As the elixir infuses their being, it mends wounds, strengthens sinew, and breathes newfound vigor into the very core of their existence.

relics.name: Echo of Resurgence
powers: If one blow were to kill you, ignore all damage and heal D10 Health instead. The Echo of Resurgence shatters afterwards
relics.desc: A product of intricate enchantments woven into a fragile crystal, this trinket hangs from a slender chain, resting gently against the wearer's heart. A single, precious irreplaceable gift is bestowed upon the bearer: a second chance at life. When faced with imminent demise, the trinket's magic awakens, casting a protective cocoon around the wearer and absorbing the fatal blow.

relics.name: Elixir of Arcane Ascendance
powers: Permanently increases your Aether by D4
relics.desc: This vial of shimmering luminescence radiates an aura of magical empowerment. When imbibed, the Elixir of Arcane Ascendance awakens a dormant wellspring of arcane potential within the consumer, elevating their casting abilities to new heights. As the elixir courses through their veins, the bearer's body becomes more in tune with the aetheric planes, allowing them to tap into arcane energies with ease.

relics.name: Ethereal Requiem Blade
powers: Attacks with this weapon ignore Armor
You can never drop this weapon unwillingly
Recover 1 Sanity after a successful Combat Encounter
relics.desc: Forged from an alloy of silvered steel and infused with fragments of star metal, the sword's blade curves with an ethereal grace. Intricate runes intertwine across its hilt, and when unsheathed, the blade hums with a melancholic resonance, its touch exuding an aura of spectral cold. With each swing, the sword sings a silent lament, its strikes capable of bypassing both armor and flesh to wound the very essence of a foe.

relics.name: Gloomheart Seed
powers: +1 Ability Point
relics.desc: When ingested, this ebony-hued seed merges seamlessly with the essence of the consumer, awakening an innate potential within. As tendrils of shadow curl through their veins, a surge of newfound strength courses through their body, bestowing an increase in power.

relics.name: Gloves of the Blazing Phoenix
powers: You're Resistant to Fire damage
Once per Camp Rest you can use the Flamecaster's Tier 4 Summon Fire Elemental Ability. The elemental disappears when you exit the room
relics.desc: These gloves woven from enchanted crimson silk and adorned with intricate patterns resembling dancing flames fit snugly against the wearer's hands, imbuing them with the power to command fire. Upon activating their magic, the wearer can summon a fiery elemental ally, a creature born of the very flames they seek to control.

relics.name: Inferno Plate
powers: This piece of armor bursts into flames when you engage in combat, dealing 1 Fire damage per round to all opponents
relics.desc: Crafted from enchanted obsidian and etched with intricate flame motifs by the enslaved Orneka blacksmiths, this plate rests upon the wearer's shoulders like a mantle of infernal power. Upon entering combat, the armor awakens, erupting into majestic flames that dance along its surface, warding off assailants with an aura of searing heat. As the wearer wades into battle, their enemies are confronted with the choice of engaging in close combat and facing the blistering flames or keeping a cautious distance.

relics.name: Mace of Eclipse
powers: +2 Force damage
Any creature struck by this mace must pass an Endurance check or be Dazed (1)
relics.desc: Bound with leather straps and accented by blackened steel, the mace's head is sculpted into a wickedly spiked orb, etched with intricate lunar motifs. When swung, the Mace of Eclipse radiates an aura of palpable darkness, its strikes carrying an otherworldly chill that engulfs enemies in an umbra of dread, weakening their resolve and sapping their strength.

relics.name: Mindward Elixir
powers: Permanently increases your Sanity by D4
relics.desc: Comprising a harmonious blend of rare herbs, moonlit dew, and crystalline extracts, this elixir embodies the essence of serenity and mental resilience. When imbibed, the Mindward Elixir envelops the consumer's psyche in a soothing embrace, fortifying their mental defenses against psychic assaults and providing solace against inner turmoils.

relics.name: Potion of Forgotten Fate
powers: Upon drinking this Potion, you automatically lose access to one of your two starting Masteries. You are free to pick a new one, assigning the same number of Ability Points that were assigned to the forgotten Mastery.
relics.desc: This swirling black liquid slushes and bubbles as if it has a mind of its own. A person drinking this mysterious liquid feels the brew eagerly sliding into their throat, choking them. After a minute of pure agony and being unable to breathe, they vomit a black crystal containing all their old power and experiences, and feel an empty space in their soul eager to be filled with new power.

relics.name: Ring of Arcane Tempest
powers: Allows the character to blast a wave of aetheric energies that deal 2D10 Arcane damage to all opponents in the room. This effect can be activated once per Camp Rest
relics.desc: Fashioned from a lustrous blend of obsidian and sapphire, the ring's surface is etched with intricate glyphs that pulse in rhythm with the surrounding arcane currents. When worn, it grants the wearer the ability to unleash a devastating wave of raw arcane power against their adversaries.

relics.name: Ring of Ethereal Grasp
powers: Grants the character 5 Aether that can only be spent on summoning Minions.
relics.desc: Crafted from a rare fusion of argent metal and a crystalline core, the ring pulsates with energy that resonates with the wearer's desire for dominion. Once worn, it unlocks the capacity to command an increased number of minions, forging an unbreakable psychic link that amplifies their reach and influence. As the wearer's will extends over the augmented horde, a fraction of their consciousness melds with their minions, bridging the chasm between individuality and collective purpose.

relics.name: Ring of Subjugated Servitude
powers: Increases the Health of Tier 1 Minions by ⅃/2
relics.desc: This twisted emblem of dominion exudes an aura of enigmatic control. When worn by its master, this obsidian ring surges with dark energy, resonating with the dark pact it embodies. It empowers the wearer's minions, elevating their potency and loyalty.

relics.name: Third Eye of Emaricus
powers: You have Advantage on all Perception and Scavenging checks
You can never be surprised
relics.desc: Hewn from a rare onyx infused with a glimmering sapphire pupil, this jewel is fashioned in the shape of a vigilant eye, its gaze eternal and all-encompassing. When held, the Third Eye of Emaricus allows the bearer an unparalleled level of awareness, becoming virtually impossible to surprise. Their gaze sees it all and everyone, even in the almost absolute darkness of Ker Nethalas.

relics.name: Vitalbane Cinch
powers: Increase your Health by 5
You gain access to the Hexmancer's Tier 4 Ability Drain Lifeforce
relics.desc: Fashioned from supple leather and woven with threads of life-affirming magic, this belt encircles the waist with a reassuring weight. Upon donning it, a surge of newfound stamina courses through the wearer's veins, bolstering their constitution and fortitude. In times of dire need, the belt's latent power can be harnessed, enabling the wearer to siphon the life force of foes through a touch, replenishing their own health while sapping the vitality of their adversaries.

relics.name: Voidclasp Gauntlets
powers: Target receives a minimum of 1 damage every time you successfully strike them, regardless of Armor or resistances
Once per Combat Encounter you may spend a Reaction to turn your opponent's attack against them, leaving you unharmed
relics.desc: Engraved sigils shimmer with a faint iridescence across these black, supple gauntlets, invoking the power of the void. The Voidclasp Gauntlets channel the power of the void into the wearer's strikes, infusing them with a dark energy that rends both armor and flesh alike.

relics.name: Wyrmfang
powers: +D6 Lightning damage
Reduce the opponent's Attack Skill by 5 each time you deal damage to them
relics.desc: Forged from a fusion of mithril and wyrm's fang, the spear's blade gleams with uncontained luminosity, evoking the power of both heaven and dragonkind, and etched along its shaft are intricate runes that pulse with radiant energy. As it is wielded, Wyrmfang burns with an inner fire, channeling the bearer's strength into piercing strikes that carry the fervor of celestial wrath.
